rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person, outlook, or community that is narrow-minded and unreceptive to outside views.

example.english: They are very insular and never take in opinions from outsiders.

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being cut off or isolated from the outside world, rather than specifically on narrow-mindedness.

example.english: That mountain village is so remote that it is almost insular.

rows.note: Use this in written or formal contexts for something pertaining to, situated on, or characteristic of an island or islands.

example.english: This reserve is known for its distinctive insular ecology.
